div.head: I Cn 7.3
div.ab: Ne na má wifa þonne án hæbbe, ⁊ þæt beo his beweddode wife, ⁊ beo be þære anre, þa hwile þe heo libbe [(þus scyldon æfre ge)], se ðe wyle Godes lage giman mid rihte ⁊ wið hellebyrne beorhgan his sawle.
[ne na má wifa þonne an hæbbe,] ac beo be þære anre, þa hwile þe heo libbe, se þe wille Godas lage gyman mid rihte ⁊ wið hellebryne beorgan his sawle.
ne na má wifa hæbbe þonne án; ac beo be þare anre, þa hwile þe heo libbe, se þe wille Godes laga giman mid rihte ⁊ wið hellebryne beorgan his sawle.
sed unam (legitimam) habeat, quamdiu uixerit, desponsatam, qui Dei legem iuste seruare desiderat et á gehenne ignibus animam suam liberare.
Ne na má wifa þonne án hæbbe ⁊ þæt beo his beweddode wif, ⁊ beo be þære anre, þa hwile þe heo libbe, se ðe wyle Godes lage giman mid rihte ⁊ wið hellebryne beorhgan his sawle.
Ne na ma wifa þonne an hæbbe, and þæt beo his beweddode wif; and beo be þære anre þa hwile þe heo libbe se ðe wyle Godes lage giman mid rihte and wið hellebryne beorhgan his sawle.

noch habe er mehr Frauen als eine, und das sei sein verlobtes Eheweib; sondern (und G) bei der einen, so lange sie lebt, bleibe, wer Gottes Gesetz richtig achten und seine Seele vor Höllenfeuer bewahren will.
nor let him have more wives than one, and that his betrothed wife; but (and, G) let whoever will rightly heed God's law and save his soul from hell-fire remain with the one as long as she lives.

And he shall have no more wives than one, and that shall be his wedded wife, and he who seeks to observe God's law aright and to save his soul from hell-fire shall remain with the one as long as she lives.

Nor may he have more than one wife, and she shall be his lawfully wedded wife; but he who desires to obey the law of God rightly and guard his soul from hellfire must stay with one wife as long as she lives.
div.note: G's ‘⁊’ before ‘beo be þære anre’ should be ‘ac’ (other MSS, Wulfstan homilies, VI Atr). ‘þus scyldon æfre ge’ should be struck as the scribe's error, peculiar to G. A lacks the beginning of 7.3 (supplied by Liebermann). Liebermann compares VI Atr 12.2.
Ne . . . wif; and: Ac A libbe: G adds, probably in error, þus scyldon æfre ge
